sloka: किम् एतन् मेघ संकाशम् पर्वतस्य अविदूरतः ।वृक्ष खण्डम् इतः भाति परम् कौतूहलम् हि मे ॥१-२८-१७॥
transliteration: kim etan megha saṁkāśam parvatasya avidūrataḥ ।vṛkṣa khaṇḍam itaḥ bhāti param kautūhalam hi me ॥1-28-17॥

translations.english: "From this side of the mountain, not faroff from here stand shining and goodlooking trees resembling clouds. It is replete scattered with animals, pleasing to the mind and extremely beautiful. It is adorned with various kinds of birds singing sweetly. What could be this? I am very curious to know.
